title: Threshold intro 3x8min
coachNotes:
EXECUTION: 3x8min at 164-170bpm, 3min jog between. Hold the TOP of the band on rep 3, do not drift over 172.
GYM: box step-downs 3x10/leg, 4s lowering, 35-40cm. Copenhagen 3x25s/side.
FUEL: nothing needed under 70min.
STOP RULE: cut to 2 reps if HRV under 45 or sleep under 6h.
WHY: first threshold work of the year. Everything long you did for Pirin sat at 134-156bpm; the race asks for 170 for two hours.
